question: What is the volume of a cylinder with radius 15 cm and height 119 cm? (Take π = 22/7)
solution:
Given:

Radius of cylinder = 15 cm

Height of cylinder = 119 cm

Formula used:

Volume of Cylinder = πr²h

Calculation:

According to the question 

Volume of cylinder 

⇒ πr²h

⇒(22)/(7)×(15)²×119

⇒Rs.84150

∴ The volume of the cylinder is Rs. 84150.
